MetaCONCUR 0.0.0.1
  • Reference

    Input a list of study-specific summary statistics in worker output format, output p-values.

    Meta.Rd

    Input a list of study-specific summary statistics in worker output format, output p-values.

    Load summary statistics (FBM + RDS or all-in-RDS)

    Meta(...)

load_chr_stats(chr_name, save_dir, use.big.memory = FALSE)

    Arguments

    ...

    One or more summary statistics lists as generated by CONCUR_Worker each for different studies.

    chr_name

    A character. Chromosome name, e.g. "chr1".

    save_dir

    A directory path where summary statistics were saved.

    use.big.memory

    Logical. If TRUE, load FBMs plus small rds; if FALSE, load full list from SS.rds.

    Value

    A named numeric vector. Element "davies" contains the probability as estimated by CompQuadForm::davies(); element "liu" contains the probability as estimated by CompQuadForm::liu().

    A list identical in structure to the output of Worker

    Functions

    • load_chr_stats(): A convenient function to retrieve Worker result

    Examples

    # Examples for meta with two studies
# Load example data
data(cnvData)
data(phenoData)
data(covData)
# Run on example data, first 100 individuals for study 1
s1_cnv <- cnvData[as.numeric(sub("P", "", cnvData$ID)) >= 1 &
                   as.numeric(sub("P", "", cnvData$ID)) <= 100, ]
s1_pheno <- phenoData[as.numeric(sub("P", "", phenoData$ID)) >= 1 &
                       as.numeric(sub("P", "", phenoData$ID)) <= 100, ]
s1_cov <- covData[as.numeric(sub("P", "", covData$ID)) >= 1 &
                   as.numeric(sub("P", "", covData$ID)) <= 100, ]
# Run on example data, 101-200 individuals for study 2
s2_cnv <- cnvData[as.numeric(sub("P", "", cnvData$ID)) >= 101 &
                   as.numeric(sub("P", "", cnvData$ID)) <= 200, ]
s2_pheno <- phenoData[as.numeric(sub("P", "", phenoData$ID)) >= 101 &
                       as.numeric(sub("P", "", phenoData$ID)) <= 200, ]
s2_cov <- covData[as.numeric(sub("P", "", covData$ID)) >= 101 &
                   as.numeric(sub("P", "", covData$ID)) <= 200, ]
cutoff.dup <- 2.3
cutoff.del <- 1.7
formula_bin <- PHEB ~ SEX
# Getting summary statistics for study 1,2
s1_SS <- CONCUR_worker(
  cnvData = s1_cnv,
  phenoData = s1_pheno,
  cutoff.dup = cutoff.dup,
  cutoff.del = cutoff.del,
  formula = formula_bin,
  covData = s1_cov,
  phenoType = "bin",
  chr = 1,
  use.big.memory = FALSE,
  save_dir = NULL
)
#> No save_dir provided, summary statistics not saved for chr1
s2_SS <- CONCUR_worker(
  cnvData = s2_cnv,
  phenoData = s2_pheno,
  cutoff.dup = cutoff.dup,
  cutoff.del = cutoff.del,
  formula = formula_bin,
  covData = s2_cov,
  phenoType = "bin",
  chr = 1,
  use.big.memory = FALSE,
  save_dir = NULL
)
#> No save_dir provided, summary statistics not saved for chr1
# Running Meta with two studies' SS chr1
res_p <- Meta(s1_SS$chr1, s2_SS$chr1)

print(res_p)
#>    davies       liu 
#> 0.7437512 0.7222249
